title: Agent and Crew Orchestration
summary: This module manages the execution and interaction of agents within CrewAI, providing adapters for various LLM frameworks, handling tool usage, and supporting both full crew orchestration and lightweight agent execution.

nodes.label: Extend Agent Functionality
nodes.title: AgentMeta
nodes.description: Provides a metaclass to dynamically extend agent capabilities, particularly for A2A (Agent-to-Agent) communication.

nodes.label: Generate Agent Plan
nodes.title: handle_reasoning
nodes.description: Utility to enable agents to generate a step-by-step plan before executing a task, enhancing decision-making. Used by legacy executors.

nodes.label: Standardize Structured Output
nodes.title: BaseConverterAdapter
nodes.description: Abstract interface for converting agent outputs into predefined structured formats like JSON or Pydantic models.

nodes.label: Orchestrate LangGraph Agents
nodes.title: LangGraphAgentAdapter
nodes.description: Integrates LangGraph-based agents into CrewAI, managing their workflow, tool usage, and memory persistence.

nodes.label: Orchestrate OpenAI Assistants
nodes.title: OpenAIAgentAdapter
nodes.description: Connects CrewAI agents with OpenAI Assistants API, handling tool configuration, structured output, and task execution.

nodes.label: Execute Crew Agent (Legacy)
nodes.title: CrewAgentExecutor
nodes.description: Manages the execution lifecycle of traditional CrewAI agents, including prompt processing, LLM interaction, and tool execution. *Note: This component is deprecated.*

nodes.label: Manage Agent Tools
nodes.title: ToolsHandler
nodes.description: Handles the invocation and caching of tools used by agents, ensuring efficient and consistent tool interactions.

nodes.label: Execute Lightweight Agent
nodes.title: LiteAgent
nodes.description: A simplified agent designed for direct message processing and tool use, suitable for scenarios not requiring full crew orchestration.

nodes.label: Large Language Model
nodes.title: LLM
nodes.description: Provides the core intelligence for agents, generating responses and making decisions based on prompts and context.

nodes.label: External Tools
nodes.title: Tools
nodes.description: External functionalities or APIs that agents can invoke to perform specific actions or retrieve information.

nodes.label: Agent-to-Agent Communication
nodes.title: A2A System
nodes.description: Enables agents to communicate and delegate tasks to other agents, potentially across different environments.

nodes.label: Agent Memory System
nodes.title: Memory
nodes.description: Stores and retrieves past interactions and learned information for agents, allowing for stateful and context-aware behavior.

nodes.label: Agent Tasks
nodes.title: Tasks
nodes.description: Specific objectives or assignments given to agents for execution.

nodes.label: Crew Orchestration
nodes.title: Crew
nodes.description: The overarching system that manages and coordinates multiple agents working together on a common goal.

groups.label: Agent Execution Core
groups.title: Agent Execution Core
groups.description: Components responsible for the fundamental execution loop, tool management, and planning for traditional CrewAI agents.

groups.label: Agent Adapters
groups.title: Agent Adapters
groups.description: Modules that integrate various LLM agent frameworks (like LangGraph and OpenAI Assistants) into CrewAI, providing a unified interface for agent behavior and structured output.

groups.label: Lightweight Agent
groups.title: Lightweight Agent
groups.description: A self-contained agent designed for direct, simpler interactions and tool usage, offering a streamlined alternative to full crew setups.

groups.label: Agent Extension Mechanisms
groups.title: Agent Extension Mechanisms
groups.description: Metaclass and utilities for extending agent capabilities, such as integrating Agent-to-Agent communication features.
